simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שֶׁבֶת (H7674) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שֶׁבֶת (shebeth) means rest , interruption , cessation First listed occurrence: Exod 21 19.

definitions.usage: cease, sit still, loss of time.
definitions.full: H7674. shebeth II. שֶׁ֫בֶת noun feminine cessation (dubious) Prov 20:3 (with ᵐ5 מֵרִיב ἀποστρέφεσθαι = שׁוּב ); שִׁבְתּוֺ Exod 21:19 i.e. from work = his loss of time (but Di I. שֶׁבֶת ). — Isa 30:7 perhaps = a sitting still (indolently) √ ישׁב , but probably corrupt, see Du Che and others
